# ankra_organisation_domain (Resource)

The organisation's own Ankra root domain, under which cluster zones and the organisation's DNS zone are created. A singleton: declare it once per organisation. Destroying it restores the platform default (`dns_root_domain_default`). The platform refuses a change, including the destroy, while cluster zones or DNS records still hang off the current domain: give `ankra_organisation_dns_record` and `ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zone` resources a `depends_on` on this resource so Terraform removes them first. Creating it takes over a domain already set in the portal, and destroying it then restores the default rather than that earlier domain. The counterpart of `ankra org domain set`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_organisation_domain" "this" {
  dns_root_domain = "k8s.example.com"
}

# Records hang off the domain, and the platform refuses to change or reset the
# domain while they exist: depending on it makes Terraform remove them first.
resource "ankra_organisation_dns_record" "logs" {
  name        = "logs"
  record_type = "CNAME"
  content     = "logs.eu-cluster.example.net"

  depends_on = [ankra_organisation_domain.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns_root_domain` (String) Root domain delegated to Ankra, such as `apps.example.com`, in lower case.

### Read-Only

- `dns_root_domain_default` (String) The platform default root domain, used when none is set.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of the singleton.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organisation domain is a singleton; any id imports it.
terraform import ankra_organisation_domain.this organisation_domain
```
